description: Angular component class for configuring range chart widgets in the Thingsboard platform, including form setup, validation, and preview functions.

classes.name: RangeChartBasicConfigComponent
classes.description: Angular component for configuring range chart widgets, extending BasicWidgetConfigComponent, managing form controls, validation, and preview functions.

methods.name: configForm
methods.description: Returns the form group used for widget configuration.

methods.name: defaultDataKeys
methods.description: Provides default data keys for the widget, e.g., temperature timeseries.

methods.name: onConfigSet
methods.description: Initializes form controls based on provided widget configuration data.

methods.name: prepareOutputConfig
methods.description: Prepares and returns the widget configuration data based on form values.

methods.name: onConfigChanged
methods.description: Handles updates when widget configuration changes, updating data keys.

methods.name: validatorTriggers
methods.description: Returns list of form control names that trigger validation updates.

methods.name: updateValidators
methods.description: Enables or disables form controls based on current configuration values for validation.

methods.name: getCardButtons
methods.description: Determines which card buttons (e.g., fullscreen) are enabled based on config.

methods.name: setCardButtons
methods.description: Sets card button states in the widget config.

methods.name: _pointLabelPreviewFn
methods.description: Generates a preview string for point labels based on current form settings.

methods.name: _tooltipValuePreviewFn
methods.description: Generates a preview string for tooltip values based on current form settings.

methods.name: _tooltipDatePreviewFn
methods.description: Generates a formatted date preview string for tooltips based on current form settings.
